description: This file contains unit tests for the path builder component in the certificate verification process, specifically testing PKITS (Public Key Infrastructure Testing and Interoperability Standards) scenarios related to revocation, distribution points, delta CRLs, and other certificate path validation features.

classes.name: CrlCheckingPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class for path building that performs CRL revocation checks after verification.

classes.name: PathBuilderPkitsTestDelegate
classes.description: A test delegate class that sets up certificate chains, trust anchors, and runs path validation tests based on PKITS test info.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Performs revocation checks on certificates in the path after initial verification.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Sets up and executes a certificate path validation test based on provided certificate and CRL DERs and test info.
